title: fix(mock): report finish_reason after a streamed prompt

files.patch:
@@ -9,6 +9,11 @@ and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0
 
 ### Fixed
 
+- **A streamed Mock prompt reports why it stopped** (`MockProvider`). The
+  mock emitted `end_turn` in its stream but never recorded it, so
+  `response.finish_reason` was `nil` after a streamed prompt, as it was not
+  for the real providers. The mock now records it like they do.
+
 - **An evaluation run is executed by one job** (`actionagent`). The run job
   read a run's status, then the scenario runner wrote `running`, as two
   steps, so a job delivered twice, or two workers that both loaded the run

@@ -142,6 +142,7 @@ def process_stream_chunk(api_response_chunk)
         when :message_delta
           delta = api_response_chunk[:delta]
           message_stack.last[:stop_reason] = delta[:stop_reason] if delta[:stop_reason]
+          self.stream_finish_reason = delta[:stop_reason] if delta[:stop_reason]
 
         when :message_stop
           # Stream complete

@@ -172,6 +172,17 @@ class MockProviderTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
     assert stream_events.any? { |e| e[:type] == :close }
   end
 
+  test "a streamed generation reports why it stopped" do
+    provider = ActiveAgent::Providers::MockProvider.new(
+      service: "Mock",
+      messages: [ { role: "user", content: "hello" } ],
+      stream: true,
+      stream_broadcaster: ->(_message, _delta, _event_type) { }
+    )
+
+    assert_equal "end_turn", provider.prompt.finish_reason
+  end
+
   test "returns appropriate response structure" do
     response = @provider.prompt
